PRODUCTION READINESS CHECK

COULD YOUR AI PILOT GO LIVE? A CHECK IN ABOUT 3 MINUTES

Ten multiple-choice questions about your pilot. You get a status for each of the five gates a pilot has to clear before production, and the blockers most likely to stall go-live.

This check covers go-live controls, not the business case.

10 questions · 5 gates · no e-mail needed

START THE CHECK

We do not keep your answers: they are scored in this browser and travel only in your result link. If an e-mail tool rewrites that link, it passes through our server to be restored, and our host’s request log holds it for at most a day. We only keep anonymous daily totals of checks started, completed and calls booked from the result. Privacy policy
